_comment: Fork-only stopgap for songs upstream's data doesn't have yet. Only fills gaps: a song upstream knows (by name + chart type) is skipped, so upstream's data always wins once it catches up, and an entry can be deleted then. lv is [Basic, Advanced, Expert, Master(, Re:Master)]; negative = only the official level is known (the minimum constant for it, e.g. 12+ -> -12.6), positive = exact internal constant.
